subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Enron: The Governance Catastrophe
description: A quick, practical guide to Enron: The Governance Catastrophe.

hook.text: Enron was America's most innovative company. Then it turned out the innovation was in the accounting.

buildup.text: Enron used off-balance-sheet entities to hide billions in debt. The board approved every questionable deal.

discovery.text: Arthur Andersen, Enron's auditor, shredded documents to hide its failure to catch the fraud.

twist.text: The board waived its own ethics code to let the CFO profit from the off-balance-sheet entities he created.

climax.text: Enron destroyed $74 billion in shareholder value. It became the textbook case for governance failure.

punchline.text: The board waived its ethics code. $74 billion vanished.

quiz.question: What did Enron's board do that worsened the scandal?
options: Waived its own ethics code for executive profit
